visual_review: Root and generating agents reviewed identity, distinct shearhead/asymmetric arm/moth/wheel/blade-dancer silhouettes, garden motifs, tool integration and complete framing.

independent_visual_review.candidate_1: Two shear blades and their pivot form the actual head; no ordinary female head remains.
independent_visual_review.candidate_2: Strong asymmetric split between the small caretaker body and one huge integrated pruning arm.
independent_visual_review.candidate_3: Two primary cutting wings and a glass abdomen create a nonhuman moth silhouette.
independent_visual_review.candidate_4: One wheel body with no human arms or legs and integrated front shear jaws.
independent_visual_review.candidate_5: Two blade forearms, long slender legs and one high/low sweeping attack stance.
independent_visual_review.common_checks: One blue flower and glass chamber in each. No four-legged forms or major clipping. Candidates 1 and 2 have narrow but complete upper margins.
